 Order
Notice has been served to the victim.

This is the third application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.360/2023 registered at Police Station - Kirnapur, District Balaghat (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(n), 376(3) of IPC and Section 5(l)/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 31.07.2024.

His earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn on merit on 27.09.2024.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he kidnapped the minor prosecutrix and committed rape upon her many times.
After investigation, offence under the aforesaid sections has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant and innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
It is NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17128 2 MCRC-14300-2025 submitted that at the time of incident, age of prosecutrix was 20 years.
In this regard, he has drawn the attention of this Court to paragraph 5 of statement of prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix herself went with the applicant.
She is consenting party.
It is submitted that prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution story.
The applicant is in jail since 31.07.2024.
Conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and submitted that date of birth of prosecutrix is 04.05.2008.
At the time of incident, prosecutrix was below 16 years of age.

Applicant committed rape with the minor prosecutrix, due to which she got Vipin Ganveer vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28875091/
1 pregnant.

In view of above, he prayed for dismissal of this bail application.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.
Looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as seriousness of offence and age of the prosecutrix, I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
Accordingly, the application stands dismissed.
